text:
anna: customer (Acme Inc, acct_org: org_abc123) says promo redeem flow returned success and they got an email with claim_id 8f3b1a7c but the org balance is still 0. reported at 2024-11-05T14:12Z. any quick checks? :eyes:

jess: can you paste the claim_id + the webhook timestamp and the org_id from the email? also, did they click any link that might map to a different account?

anna: claim_id: `8f3b1a7c`
webhook received at: `2024-11-05T14:11:43Z`
email payload shows: `{"claim_id":"8f3b1a7c","org_id":"org_abc123","amount":5000}`
customer asserts UI showed green check and "Credits applied", screenshot attached.

infra-bot: webhook POST /partner/webhook/claim 200 OK (req_id: req_98765). Payload logged to s3://ingest-logs/2024-11-05/8f3b1a7c.json.

sam: quick repro steps I'm running: 1) find webhook log 2) check grants ingestion pipeline 3) check ledger write. running queries now.

sam: query result: there is a ledger row with tx_id `tx_4492` referencing claim_id `8f3b1a7c` but billing_account_id is `org_abc123 ` (note trailing space). that means the grant landed on a different synthetic id (string mismatch).

mike: hmm trailing whitespace in billing_account_id mapping — looks like partner system sometimes appends a newline/space. we trim strings on our side in a few places but not in the grants ingestion microservice (grant-ingest).

jess: can you paste the exact ledger row?

sam: row: `INSERT INTO ledger (tx_id, claim_id, billing_account_id, amount, created_at) VALUES ('tx_4492','8f3b1a7c','org_abc123 ',5000,'2024-11-05T14:11:44Z')`

mike: root cause likely: partner webhook included org_id with trailing space -> grant-ingest didn't sanitize -> ledger used raw string -> account lookup for org_abc123 (no space) didn't match so UI shows zero balance.

jess: plan: 1) manual fix for this customer: copy ledger row and update billing_account_id to `org_abc123` (idempotent write), emit audit entry, notify customer. 2) patch grant-ingest to trim whitespace on `org_id` and add unit + integration test. 3) backfill: run a script to find ledger rows with billing_account_id that matches pattern `org_.*\s+$` and confirm.

mike: I'll do the patch and deploy to staging, and also add a small schema validation on the partner webhook contract (strip and reject suspicious chars). estimating 2h for patch + tests.

sam: I'll run the backfill query now to surface other affected rows: `SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE billing_account_id ~ '^[a-z0-9_]+\\s+$';`

anna: customer is ok with manual fix if we can confirm no double-credit. please proceed, customer waiting.

mike: manual remediation steps I'm going to take now: 1) create compensating row referencing original tx_id as correction (internal memo), or prefer updating existing row? jess: which do we prefer for audit?

jess: prefer audit-friendly approach: keep original row, insert a corrective ledger entry with negative amount referencing bad row, then insert correct positive row under the right billing_account_id. that preserves immutability and traceability. include `meta: {"investigation":"support/2048723456"}`.

mike: agreed. performing these DB ops in a transaction and will attach the audit log. will ping when done.

infra-bot: deployment webhook: grant-ingest patch PR #3245 merged to main, CI green, deploying to staging.

sam: backfill query returned 6 rows across last 30 days with trailing whitespace pattern — we'll include them in a patch-run script to either correct or flag for manual review depending on checksum.

mike: remediation done for Acme Inc: inserted correction tx `tx_4492-correct` and new credit `tx_4492-fixed`. audit log s3://audit-logs/tx_4492-fix.json. notified customer via support ticket #5543.

anna: letting customer know — they confirmed balance reflected after our fix. :handshake: Marking P1 -> resolved for now but recommend postmortem and partner escalation.

jess: filing a short postmortem: root cause = missing trim on partner `org_id` in grant-ingest; action items: patch live (mike), backfill script + run (sam), add webhook schema validation (mike), notify partner and ask them to stop sending trailing whitespace (anna). deadline EOD today for hotfix.

mike: will open PR to add trimming + tests and schedule prod deploy during low traffic window.

anna: thanks team. closing thread after PM posts postmortem link.
